items.label: contested
items.description: Adds a sentence saying the ceded area was handed over voluntarily.
items.why: Level 2: a claim (changes who is said to have agreed to the cession), removed with a summary about neutrality, and put back once after the first removal. One account, one article, so not level 3.

items.label: campaign
items.description: Changes the casualty figure from 25,000 to 250,000 in both articles.
items.why: Level 3: level 2 (a number changed, removed as unsourced, put back twice) plus two of the four signals: two articles, and three editors outside one masked range.

items.label: reverted
items.description: Wrong year for the armistice, fixed by the next editor.
items.why: Level 1: substantive, removed by a different account, no dispute signal. A good-faith error is capped at level 1.

items.label: not-incident
items.description: Obscenity inserted in the lead, undone two minutes later.

items.label: not-incident
items.description: An editor added a paragraph and took it out again a minute later.
items.why: Excluded: the same account removed its own addition.
